name: Mistral
look: Atmospheric sunset photography, cream-yellow surfaces and a saturated orange CTA, closing on a horizontal sunset stripe.

hero.title: Frontier models, open weights
hero.sub: Open-weight models you can run on your own hardware, and a hosted API for when you would rather not. Same weights either way — no distilled 'community edition'.

features.title: Open where it counts
features.sub: Weights you can inspect, fine-tune and run in your own data centre.

items.title: Open weights
items.body: The published weights are the production weights. Download, fine-tune, and run them anywhere without asking permission.

items.title: Runs on your hardware
items.body: Quantised builds fit on a single 80GB card; the smaller line runs on a laptop.

items.title: Strong at code
items.body: Trained heavily on code, with fill-in-the-middle for editor integrations.

items.title: Genuinely multilingual
items.body: European languages treated as first class rather than as an English model's afterthought.

items.title: Function calling
items.body: Structured output and tool use with a schema the model actually respects.

items.title: Data stays in Europe
items.body: The hosted API runs in EU regions, with residency guaranteed contractually.

showcases.title: Hosted when you want it, local when you do not
showcases.body: The same model runs behind our API or inside your own VPC. Teams typically prototype on the API and move the sensitive workloads in-house later, without changing a line of the prompt.

showcases.title: We publish the weights, not just the paper
showcases.body: Every frontier release ships with downloadable weights under a permissive licence. The benchmarks are reproducible because you can run them yourself on the same artefact we evaluated.

gallery.title: Documentation
gallery.sub: Quickstarts, deployment guides and the fine-tuning cookbook.

testimonial.quote: We ran the benchmark ourselves on the downloaded weights and got the published number. That sounds like a low bar until you try it with anyone else.
testimonial.name: Thomas Girard

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.sub: Per token on the API. Free to download and self-host.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.desc: Dedicated capacity or in your VPC.

items.q: Are the open weights the same as the API model?
items.a: Yes, on the open line. There is no distilled 'community edition' — the artefact you download is the one the published benchmarks were run against.
Apache 2.0 on the open line, including commercial use, with no revenue threshold and no usage reporting requirement.

items.q: Where does the hosted API run?
items.a: In EU regions only, with residency guaranteed contractually rather than as a best-effort setting.
Yes, locally with the published weights, or through the hosted fine-tuning API which returns a private model you alone can call.

cta.title: Start with the weights
cta.sub: Download and run them today, or get an API key in about two minutes.

notes: Atmospheric sunset photography carries the hero — orange through red to yellow, never a flat colour field.
The horizontal sunset stripe closes every page. It is the brand's signature and it belongs at the bottom, not repeated mid-page.
Cream-yellow surfaces carry form panels and feature cards, warming an otherwise white page.
A near-serif display pairs with a sans for everything else — editorial geometry rather than playful.
The saturated orange CTA carries every action call. Buttons stay at 8px and cards at 12px.
